title: Indore Bhagirathpura drinking water contamination, Dec 2025 - Jan 2026
claim: case study only; no detection result is computed
label: reconstruction from public reports; dates are as each source states them, conflicting dates are kept as separate entries

place.ward: Ward No. 11 of Indore Municipal Corporation

wardSource.name: Madhya Pradesh High Court, Indore bench, order in WP No. 50641 of 2025, dated 06-01-2026, para 1

events.what: First death, per cremation ground records: a 50-year-old woman visiting from Bihar was cremated on 21 December after 10-12 days of stomach pain, vomiting and diarrhoea.
events.sourceSays: the first death occurred on December 21, not a few days ago as officially suggested
events.source: Free Press Journal, "MP News: Bhagirathpura Turns Into A Death Zone" (updated 1 Jan 2026)

events.what: Cases first reported (date as given by Scroll in its report on the High Court appointing an inquiry commission).
events.sourceSays: The cases were first reported on December 24.
